title: Unique Award | 2023 CHINA AIGC 100
summary: AI is among the most transformative technologies of our time — remaking industries and posing new opportunities and risks. Unique Capital’s renewed mission is to empower and accelerate healthy growth of China’s AI applications and industry.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / Unique Award · January 24, 2024

AI is among the most transformative technologies of our time — remaking industries and posing new opportunities and risks. Unique Capital’s renewed mission is to empower and accelerate healthy growth of China’s AI applications and industry.

As a boutique investment bank focused on global AI, Unique Capital looks for AI application companies with inventive thinking, strong execution, and social responsibility. Outside affirmation at moments of self-doubt can unlock vitality; letting the industry hear those builders also lifts peers. Hence the 2023 AIGC 100 selection — to surface high-potential domestic AI applications and support high-quality industry development.

What AIGC 100 is

A professional, fair selection of 100 leading companies deep in pan-AI applications across education, healthcare, finance, retail, logistics, manufacturing, entertainment, and more. Honorees combine strong AI tech/products with viable business models and social value — category leaders and pace-setters.

Support for selected companies

  • Financing acceleration — priority investment access and professional advisory to raise capital faster.
  • Brand amplification — coverage across mainstream media, social platforms, and industry forums.
  • Industry resources — introductions to government, associations, academia, and partners to widen markets and networks.

Congratulations to the 100 selected companies — and expectations for stronger 2024. (The named list is image-primary in the CN source; attach boards on ingest rather than inventing names from charts.)

About Unique Capital

Unique Capital is a full-value-chain research boutique bank for the digital commerce ecosystem — industry research, financing advisory and matching, investment management, and industry events — via Unique Capital, Unique Research, Unique Go-Global media, UniqueClub / AI circle tools, deal-matching products, and UniqueBloom event platforms. Hundreds of companies invested in or advised to date.

3 CN images (award boards / list visuals); attach on ingest — company list image-primary.

— END —
